conviction_note: The top line is pre-released: CARVYKTI $710m, Legend's own 6-K of 2026-10-13, implies about $360m of revenue against a $358-360m consensus. Q3 gross margin (low 50s) and tax (high 20s) were guided in August. So the print turns on the new CEO's first call, the Q4 margin rebound and how the call frames competition. The stock is up 35% in 20 sessions and 14% in 5 into a print with nothing new on the top line, and it sold its last two prints. That gives a mild negative lean, p_up 45, on an abs move of 6.5%. An ATM IV of 82.6% backs that size, though the chain is too wide to quote a straddle. The findings sum to -1.5 and the scaled number is -0.65. The gap is because several small negatives lean the same way on a run-up the market can see, so p_up stays near 50.
bar: Revenue: about $358-360m from two estimate sources that agree. Earnings Whispers gives $359.9m (https://finviz.com/news/413913/legend-biotech-must-prove-its-first-profit-was-no-fluke-as-margins-reset, 2026-11-03) and Benzinga $358.3m (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/LEGN/earnings-forecasts, per a search snippet). EPS is DISPUTED: $0.01 at Earnings Whispers and Benzinga, $0.07 on another Earnings Whispers page, $0.16 at MarketBeat. GAAP and adjusted figures are probably mixed together, so any EPS or margin-dependent finding is capped small. Company guide (Q2 call, 2026-08-11, https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/08/11/legend-biotech-legn-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/): Q3 gross margin on net product sales in the 'lower 50% range'; Q4 mid-50s; tax rate high 20s; positive adjusted net income in Q3 and Q4 individually. My revenue estimate is the collaboration revenue ratio (49.6-50.0% of net trade sales in Q1 and Q2 2026) times $710m = about $353m, plus about $6m of non-milestone license revenue, so about $360m.
positioning_check: Short interest 16.4m shares at the 2026-09-30 FINRA settlement, up from 14.6m on 2026-09-15, days to cover 7.1 (curvedtrading.com via search snippet; the page itself returned 403). That is roughly 8-9% of about 190m ADS outstanding: elevated, not crowded. No October settlement found. No usable skew: the chain is 'unusable_chain' (ATM spread 148% of mid), skew_25d null, put/call OI 0.30 (call-heavy), ATM IV 82.6% on the 2026-11-20 expiry. Tape: +35.1% over 20 sessions, +14.0% over 5, 33.7% below the 52-week high (about $37.50 in June after the LB2501 data), 44% above the 52-week low (about $16.86 after the CEO exit and the Q2 print).

findings.finding: Q3 top line is pre-released and in line. Legend's 6-K of 2026-10-13 gives CARVYKTI net trade sales of about $710m (Q2 $657m, Q1 $597m). At the 49.6-50.0% collaboration-revenue ratio of Q1 and Q2 2026, plus about $6m of non-milestone license revenue, Legend's total revenue comes to about $360m. Consensus is $358-360m, so the print is about +0.3% vs bar, unless an unannounced Janssen milestone lands in license revenue (Q2 carried $56m of milestones).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The pre-release itself moved the stock +0.45% on 2026-10-13 (baseline). Q2 2026 was a revenue beat ($387.5m incl. milestones) and first GAAP profit, and the stock fell 5.36% on 2026-08-12 with an Oppenheimer downgrade. Q1 2026 fell about 4% premarket on an EPS miss despite +64% revenue.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. Consensus already sits at the implied $360m. Listed for completeness and for the milestone tail only. If a milestone were expected, consensus would sit above $370m.
findings.independence: J&J Q3 2026 release via Zacks/finsee: Carvykti $710m, +35% (https://finsee.ai/earnings/jnj/2026/q3/en/). Same underlying number, from Janssen.

findings.finding: CARVYKTI growth is decelerating: +62% YoY in Q1 2026, +50% in Q2, +35% in Q3; sequential +10% in Q2, then +8% in Q3. Over the same period J&J's off-the-shelf bispecific Tecvayli grew 77% to $312m after its second-line approval in March 2026, and Gilead/Arcellx's anito-cel has a PDUFA date of 2026-12-23. The new CEO's first call will have to address competition in second line, which Oppenheimer already cited when it downgraded on 2026-08-12.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Oppenheimer's competition and CEO-transition downgrade (2026-08-12) came with -5.36% that day. The CEO exit of 2026-07-27 brought -15%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the sales numbers are public. What is not priced is the CEO's framing of the Q4 and 2027 trajectory against Tecvayli 2L and anito-cel. The +35% run-up says the market is looking at the pipeline (in vivo) rather than the slowing core; if this were priced the stock would not have rallied into a print with a decelerating, already-known top line.
findings.independence: Oppenheimer downgrade citing competition: https://www-web.itiger.com/news/2658909519. Anito-cel PDUFA 2026-12-23: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260427408690/en/gilead-sciences-completes-acquisition-of-arcellx-ahead-of-potential-commercial-launch-of-anito-cel/

findings.finding: Gross margin on net product sales has been volatile: 41% in Q1 2026 (one-time capacity-expansion costs), 58% in Q2 (a few points of one-time favorability), with Q3 guided to the 'lower 50% range' and Q4 to mid-50s. A print outside low-50s, or any change to the Q4 rebound, is the line most likely to surprise. The guide itself is public and consensus is built on it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 margin miss (41%): stock fell about 4% premarket (2026-05-12). Q2 margin of 58% plus a guide-down to low 50s: -5.36% on 2026-08-12.
findings.why_not_priced: Inside what the company guided, so mostly priced. A small negative tilt because this name's margin line has twice disappointed on the print. The EPS bar is disputed ($0.01/$0.07/$0.16), so the size is capped.
findings.independence: Q1 2026 6-K MD&A attributes the 41% to one-time capacity costs: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001801198/000180119826000014/legn-20260331.htm. Same company source family.

findings.finding: This is the first earnings call for CEO Ingrid Zhang, ex-chief commercial officer of Novartis International, in post since 2026-09-15. Ying Huang left in July (-15% on 2026-07-27) and Alan Bash was interim. A new outside CEO's first quarter can bring a reset (strategy, opex, in vivo prioritisation, first 2027 framing) in either direction. A kitchen-sink is the more common first-call pattern.
findings.why_not_priced: The direction cannot be priced in advance. The wide range is the point: if a reset were priced, the stock would not be at +35% over 20 sessions.
findings.independence: Fierce Pharma coverage of the appointment: https://www.fiercepharma.com/pharma/legend-biotech-names-novartis-veteran-ingrid-zhang-new-ceo

findings.finding: The stock ran into the print: +35.1% over 20 sessions and +14.0% over 5, from $21.10 on 2026-11-03 to about $24.06 intraday on 2026-11-09. The only dated catalyst is the 2026-11-04 ASH abstract release (LB2501 in vivo CAR-T, 8 patients at DL2, 100% ORR/CR; +6.0% that day). No analyst changed rating in the month to 2026-11-06. Expectations for the call are raised on a top line that is already known.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last two confirmed prints were sold: Q1 2026 about -4% premarket, Q2 2026 -5.36% on the day after. That is a confirmed-release base rate, unlike the baseline's 6-K history, which mixes in non-earnings filings.
findings.why_not_priced: The run-up is itself the price. The question is whether the call can justify it with nothing new on the top line. If the market expected a sell-the-news, the stock would have stalled into the print rather than rising another 3% on the eve.
findings.independence: ASH abstract release 2026-11-04: https://finviz.com/news/415469/legend-biotech-to-showcase-carvykti-leadership-and-next-generation-cell-therapy-innovation-at-ash-2026. Baseline tape run_up_5d 14.0 / 20d 35.14.

findings.finding: Financing: management said on the Q2 call it expects to fully settle the roughly $300m J&J loan in 2026 through cash and profit recoupment. Janssen's $266m of funding advances is classified as current. Cash and time deposits were about $965m at 2026-06-30 after the $212m June raise. What the money buys is the end of the J&J liability and in vivo funding, with no distress, so the Q3 balance sheet should show deleveraging and lower interest expense.
findings.why_not_priced: Known and guided, so small. Listed because cash after repayment is the number a value-focused new CEO may frame capital allocation around.
findings.independence: Q2 call transcript (same company, different document): https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/08/11/legend-biotech-legn-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/

findings.finding: Tax: Q2 2026 tax expense was $22.3m on about $55.5m pretax (about 40%), against a guided 'high 20s' rate. The provision includes an unexecuted China advance pricing agreement, and the release warns the final liability may differ materially. A true-up could swing GAAP EPS against a disputed $0.01-0.16 bar.

findings.why_not_priced: Below operating income, with no path to the guide unless the APA is executed. Sized at a fraction.

lessons_applied: Rule 1 (verified fact is not a reaction): pre-released revenue finding cut from +0.2 to +0.1
Rule 6 (bar disputed on EPS): margin and tax findings kept capped small; revenue bar is two agreeing sources so print_vs_bar stays on revenue
Base-rate rule for untrustworthy FPI history: rebuilt from the confirmed Q1 and Q2 2026 reactions (both sold), and kept abs_move at 6.5 rather than the baseline's 1.84
Pessimism artefact plus rule 5 (positioning is not a cause): run-up finding cut from -1.0 to -0.8 and competition finding from -0.8 to -0.6 (partly priced, public numbers)
Rule 3 (caveat reaches the number): CEO-call finding has a two-sided range, so it was cut from -0.3 to -0.2
